reading.reading0: No changing line: read the primary hexagram judgment
reading.reading1: One changing line: read that line of the primary hexagram
reading.reading2: Two changing lines: read both lines (upper one leads)
reading.reading3: Three changing lines: read both hexagram judgments
reading.reading4: Four changing lines: read the two unchanged lines of the resulting hexagram (lower one leads)
reading.reading5: Five changing lines: read the unchanged line of the resulting hexagram
reading.reading6: Six changing lines: read the resulting hexagram judgment
